topic: Testing with pytest and Test-Driven Development
learningObjectives: Write unit tests for Python functions using pytest.
Use assertions and fixtures to verify program behavior.
Apply a basic test-driven development workflow.

activities.title: TDD Workflow
activities.instruction: Arrange the core TDD cycle in the correct order.

content.concept: Test-driven development commonly follows a Red-Green-Refactor cycle: write a failing test, implement enough code to pass it, then improve the implementation.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

goal: 1. Write a test for the desired behavior
2. Run the test and observe failure
4. Run the test and observe success
5. Refactor while keeping the tests passing

activities.title: pytest Assertion Anatomy
activities.instruction: Click each part of the assertion to understand what it verifies.

content.concept: A pytest assertion checks whether an actual expression matches the expected behavior.
